## Problem statement

Before proposing an integrated-workbench change, use the
[Wald tools catalog](https://reblocke.github.io/wald-inference-tools/) to identify the focused
repository that owns a single inferential question:

- [Compatibility curve](https://github.com/reblocke/compatibility-curve)
- [Wald likelihood support](https://github.com/reblocke/wald-likelihood-support)
- [Critical effect size](https://github.com/reblocke/critical-effect-size)
- [Type S/M calibrator](https://github.com/reblocke/type-s-m-calibrator)
- [Precision guardrail planner](https://github.com/reblocke/precision-guardrail-planner)
- [Numerical Core](https://github.com/reblocke/wald-inference-core)

This repository is feature-frozen for advanced integrated comparison. Supported requests normally
cover Core upgrades, correctness, accessibility, security, browser compatibility, or
documentation/portfolio links.
